title: A part sale split off another keeps its representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer whose "Sales Representative - Part Sales" is sales rep C.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced part sale for this test for that customer, with two parts and its Sales Representative set to sales rep A.
  • Open the part sale in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Split the part sale with Split Part Sale, moving one part to the new part sale.
  2. Open the new part sale and read its Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A new part sale is created.

Step 2:

  • Its one Sales Representative field reads sales rep A, not the customer's sales rep C.
  • There is no + beside it.

Split Part Sale comes from Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266). If that is not on the build being tested, mark this case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R29: “A work order or part sale made from another one, by Split Work Order, Split Part Sale or reopening a paid work order, starts with the representatives of the one it came from: one field, or the Labor and Parts fields with the same people. It does not take the customer's.”
  • S2-N2: “A part sale's card has no + button. A part sale keeps one Sales Representative field, exactly as Part Sales Update v1 builds it: its label stays "Sales representative" and its look and behavior do not change.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 6 files (copy on split and reopen): “Copy the source's reps + split state”
